title: 第23章 翡城第24章 珍宝阁
slug: 为了长生不死我带着全宗修仙
content_zh:
;;
“挺好，都挺好的。”
寂月假笑着，“修为之事，不可急切，稳打稳扎为主。收拾收拾东西，明天去翡城。”
洗髓丹的价值可不能随便在一个铺子就卖出去，最好的方法是以拍卖的形式。
翡城是离这里比较近的一座城池，最近有一场拍卖会，听说还有什么秘境地图出现，吸引了不少修士前去。
寂月打算在拍卖会上把丹药卖了，攒一波灵石，再去找个山头建设自己的宗门。
“我知道翡城，我之前也去过，到时候我给你们当向导！”花玲珑忍不住举手发言，作为他们这些人当中最富贵的，她觉得自己有这个责任。
“那就麻烦三师姐了。”宁青青小声地说。
叶无忧揽着花玲珑的肩膀，笑嘻嘻地说：“倒是我这个做师姐的要仰仗你这个师妹了。”
“二师姐说笑了，我们师姐师妹之间哪有什么仰仗不仰仗的。”
“不过说实话，我还真没去过翡城，有什么好吃的好玩的吗？”
“有啊，我跟你说，他们那有一家饭店的香醉鸡可好吃了，不过每次都要提前预定……”
寂月在她们聊天的时候，把莫离招了过来。
“尊上，有什么事吗？”莫离小心翼翼地站了过去，表情有些羞愧。
当初是他死皮赖脸地待在尊上身边，但是这么久时间过去了，他还没有引气入体，尊上会不会嫌弃他太废物了，想把他放弃？
想到这里，心里不免泛起一阵酸楚，似乎黑暗里伸出了一双手，想要将他拉进去。
寂月不知道这小孩心里在想什么，但是知道一个道理，在神童堆里待着的普通小孩，很容易产生自卑心理。
既然把人带在身边，也算是半个姐姐吧，好歹别让人弄出心理问题来。
“修炼的怎么样？”
“回尊上，我，我，我还是没办法引气入体。对不起，辜负了尊上的期待。”莫离低着头，等待着最后的判决。

却听对方说：“想也如此了，你灵根多而杂，想要引气入体不是一件易事。所以你需得比寻常人花上数倍的努力，这样方能得到一个结果。你也不必着急，是你这几个师姐师妹妖孽了些，并非你的问题。”
“你大概也知道，寻常五行灵根最后沦落成了普通人，少有机会走上这条路的。有时候天赋不一定能决定所有，焉知努力后没有好结局？”
寂月的语调不急不缓，声音温柔又带着力量，渐渐抚平了那颗焦躁不安的心。
“尊上，我也可以修仙吗？”莫离很是忐忑，如果是其他人的话，肯定是嘲笑他一番，说他一个五灵根如何修仙？
可他知道，寂月是不一样的，她不会嘲笑他，而且还会安慰。
“你有灵根为何不能修仙？”寂月反问。
“可是我……”
“莫离，你要知道，自怨自艾是没有结果的。你的目标是什么，那你就朝着那个目标前进。倘若你从未努力过，你又为什么不能直视自己的失败呢？”
“尊上，我明白了。”莫离坚定地点点头，说：“我会继续努力下去的，无论是花费百倍千倍的时间，我终有一天会成功！”
“嗯，你明白就好。”
寂月见这小孩终于不钻牛角尖了，这才松了一口气。
这孩子天生是走剑修这一路的，可是她除了一个《九霄云雷剑法》外，就不会其他的东西。

"Very good, everything is good."
Jiyue smirked, "Don't be impatient when it comes to your cultivation. Take it slow and steady. Pack your things and go to Feicheng tomorrow."
The value of the Marrow Cleansing Pill cannot be sold casually in a shop. The best way is to auction it.
Feicheng is a city relatively close to here. There was an auction recently, and I heard that some secret maps appeared, attracting many monks.
Jiyue planned to sell the elixirs at the auction, save up a wave of spiritual stones, and then find a hilltop to build her own sect.
"I know Feicheng. I have been there before. I will be your guide when the time comes!" Hua Linglong couldn't help raising her hands to speak. As the richest among them, she felt that she had this responsibility.
"Then I'll trouble Third Senior Sister." Ning Qingqing said softly.
Ye Wuyou put his arms around Hua Linglong's shoulders and said with a smile, "As a senior sister, I have to rely on you as a junior sister."
"Second Senior Sister is joking. There is nothing we, Senior Sisters, cannot rely on."
"But to be honest, I have never been to Feicheng. Is there anything good to eat or do?"
"Yes, let me tell you, they have a restaurant where the drunken chicken is delicious, but you have to make a reservation in advance every time..."
While they were chatting, Ji Yue summoned Mo Li over.
"Your Majesty, what's the matter?" Li Li stood over cautiously, his expression a little ashamed.
At first, he stayed by His Majesty's side shamelessly, but after so long, he still hasn't introduced Qi into his body. Will Your Majesty think that he is such a waste and want to give up on him?
Thinking of this, I couldn't help but feel a burst of sadness in my heart, as if a pair of hands stretched out from the darkness, trying to pull him in.
Jiyue didn't know what was going on in this child's mind, but she knew that an ordinary child among prodigies would easily develop an inferiority complex.
Since you have someone by your side, you can be regarded as half a sister. At least don't let others cause psychological problems.
"How are you practicing?"
"Back to Your Majesty, I, I, I still can't bring the Qi into my body. I'm sorry, I failed to live up to Your Majesty's expectations." Li Li lowered his head, waiting for the final judgment.
But I heard the other party say: "I think so. You have many spiritual roots and are mixed. It is not easy to introduce Qi into your body. Therefore, you need to work several times harder than ordinary people to get a result. You don't have to worry. It's your senior sisters who are a bit evil, and it's not your problem."
"You probably also know that the ordinary Five Elements Spiritual Roots eventually become ordinary people, and there are few opportunities to embark on this path. Sometimes talent may not determine everything. How could you know that after hard work, there will be no good ending?"
Jiyue's tone was neither urgent nor slow, and her voice was gentle and powerful, gradually soothing her restless heart.
"Your Majesty, can I also become an immortal?" Mo Li was very worried. If it were someone else, they would definitely laugh at him, saying how could he become an immortal with only five spiritual roots?
But he knew that Jiyue was different. She would not laugh at him, but would also comfort him.
"Why can't you cultivate immortality if you have spiritual roots?" Jiyue asked back.
"But I..."
"Mo Li, you have to know that there is no result in feeling sorry for yourself. Whatever your goal is, then you should move towards that goal. If you have never worked hard, why can't you look at your failure?"
"Your Majesty, I understand." Li Li nodded firmly and said, "I will continue to work hard. No matter how long it takes, I will succeed one day!"
"Well, as long as you understand."
Jiyue breathed a sigh of relief when she saw that the child finally stopped trying to get into trouble.
This child was born to practice swordsmanship, but apart from the "Nine Heavens Cloud Thunder Sword Technique", she didn't know anything else.
